_note: Static facts about what is on North Dakota's ballot. Every line carries its source. Edit freely; confirm final candidate lists at vote.nd.gov.

facts.label: Election Day
facts.text: Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Per Multistate, the last polls in North Dakota close at 9 PM ET.

facts.label: Counting
facts.text: Election-night results are unofficial. Counties submit results and the State Canvassing Board certifies them later (it certified the June primary on June 24).

facts.label: Recounts
facts.text: Per AP Decision Notes, ballot measures decided by a margin of 0.25% or less are recounted automatically.

facts.label: Turnout context
facts.text: About 372,000 North Dakotans voted in the 2024 general election; about 594,000 were eligible. June 2026 primary turnout was 20.84% (125,101 ballots).
facts.source: AP Decision Notes; ND Secretary of State
